data_label: Synthetic data for the fictional Example University.
description: The week of unusually cold weather in the generated year (hours 889 to 1056), with its own demand and one of four boilers out for 48 hours, so the plant cannot meet the peak. This is a different week from the Cold snap tab, which raises every load 50 percent for 48 hours in the normal winter week.
model_label: Steady-state physics per hour with plant ramp coupling between hours. No pipe transients and no valves.

deeper_derate.description: Stress case: only one of four boilers running through 9 peak hours of the cold-snap week.
deeper_derate.title: One boiler running

priority_comparison.note: Each pair of cases solves the same hours. Buildings with equal weights can trade shed load almost freely, so read the totals by type rather than the split between buildings.
